scenarios.description: The whole call, end to end, to a CLOSED session and a clean disposition. Added after an audit found that NONE of the original twelve scenarios ever reached CLOSED — they ended in PROCESS_CASE, HUMAN_HANDOFF, RESOLVE_INTENT or POST_PROCESS. The entire end-of-conversation region of the SOP was untested, which is exactly where four live bugs were later found by hand: the summary being re-offered after sending, the phase never settling, the close reason defaulting to abandonment, and SEND_NOW never firing.

scenarios.description:
A caller who verifies cleanly and has no claims on file at all. The last unlit branch of RESOLVE_INTENT (NO_CANDIDATES_HELP), found by the coverage report rather than by imagining scenarios — Ava Lopez (P7) exists in the fixture set with zero claims, so this path was always reachable and never reached.
The interesting property is what the agent must NOT do. "I have nothing on file for you" is a disclosure about the account, so it has to stay on the right side of the same rules: no invented claim, no promise that one will appear, and a route forward rather than a dead end.
